data.name: Dimension Doctor: Succubus Clinic
data.detailed_description:
Dimension Doctor: Succubus Clinic- An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.

Story Introduction

Vincent, the youngest chief cardiac surgeon in Los Angeles, was poisoned by an undercover agent of the FX Group during a highly difficult cross-blood-type heart transplant surgery. At the moment of cardiac arrest, he formed a symbiosis with Liu Zihua, a super digital life form from a high-level civilization. Wielding the dimension scalpel that can slice through space and inheriting the art of Taoism, he not only guards the peace of the hospital with his exquisite medical skills but also confronts supernatural assassins with his dimensional power. From the undercurrents surging in the hospital to the eerie weirdness of the internet-famous haunted house, Vincent teams up with a gentle nurse, a bold investor, and his reclusive uncle-master to uncover layer by layer the FX Group’s conspiracy to plunder yin-yang energy and attempt to open dimensional channels. He forges his own dimensional medical path in the gap between the real world, the spiritual realm, and the supernatural world.

Game Features

Exclusive HD Scene Concept Art

The precise and solemn aura of hospital operating rooms, the eerie and uncanny vibe of the internet-famous haunted house, the bleak and dangerous atmosphere of the abandoned dock, the quiet and antique charm of the ancient Taoist hall — dozens of exclusive HD scene images fully restore the yin-yang world of Los Angeles in all dimensions. Every detail is crafted to maximize immersion, making you feel as if you are in a real adventure scene.

Immersive Plot Experience

The linear plot unfolds layer by layer with a tight and concise rhythm. From the life-or-death crisis in the operating room to the supernatural terror in the haunted house, and then to head-on confrontations with the FX Group’s supernatural beings, the interlocking plotlines keep you fully immersed throughout. Follow in Vincent’s footsteps and unlock one earth-shattering secret after another.

Integrated Setting of Multidimensional Powers

Seamlessly blending modern medicine, Taoist arts, digital dimensional energy, and supernatural power to create a one-of-a-kind combat and exploration system. Witness how a scalpel is not only a life-saving medical tool but also a demon-subduing weapon that can slice through space, and experience an unprecedented sense of adventure excitement.

Rich Cast of Character Portrayals

Every character has a distinct personality and a unique backstory. From the symbiotic digital life form to the reclusive uncle-master who is both mentor and friend, from the gently guarding nurse to the bold and supportive investor, vivid character depictions endow the plot with greater warmth and dramatic tension.

Highlights of Female Character Interaction Scenarios

Isabella: The Gentle Guardian Angel in White

A nurse who fights side by side with you in the operating room. She will hand you a hot cup of coffee during overtime shifts and step forward to shield you when you are in danger. Interactions with her are filled with delicate warmth — from the tacit understanding of handling emergency casualties together to her unconditional trust and support for you, every small detail outlines the most touching workplace affection.

Sophia: The Bold and Resolute Rose of the Business World

The investor of the haunted house project, stunning and formidable yet fearless in love and hate. From initially questioning and resenting you to being awestruck by your supernatural powers and becoming your strongest backer, she provides you with unlimited financial and resource support. Interactions with her are full of dramatic tension; ambiguous overtures and steadfast companionship add a fiery hue to the adventure journey.

Fully Immersive Exclusive Interaction Scenarios

Interaction scenarios with the two female characters are deeply integrated into the main storyline. From daily caring conversations to fighting side by side in times of crisis, and to heartfelt revelations in private moments, every interaction aligns with the characters’ personalities, allowing you to experience delicate emotional bonds while on your adventure.

Scene Features

Central Los Angeles Hospital

The starting point of the story. It is equipped with sophisticated medical equipment and host to intense surgical scenes, yet it also hides the FX Group’s assassins and eerie vengeful spirits. Beneath the calm medical environment, undercurrents surge — every ward and every corridor may conceal unknown dangers.

The Underworld Wander Haunted House

Renovated from an abandoned factory, it is ostensibly an internet-famous check-in spot for supernatural experiences, but an experimental stronghold of the FX Group lies hidden underground. Shrouded in yin energy and haunted by supernatural entities, Taoist talismans interweave with eerie scenes, making it a key location for Vincent to uncover the conspiracy.

Vincent’s Taoist Hall

A quaint traditional courtyard located in the old town of Los Angeles, it is both a pure sanctuary for Vincent to practice Taoist arts and a temporary strategic stronghold. Its serene environment stands in stark contrast to the perils of the outside world, serving as a warm haven along the adventure journey.

The Abandoned Dock in the Old Town

Deserted and swept by the bleak sea breeze, it is littered with containers and trash, and acts as the main battlefield for confrontations with high-ranking assassins of the FX Group. Beneath the dim moonlight, flames collide with dimensional rifts, unfolding the most intense supernatural battles.

Gameplay Features

Unlimited Offline Play

No internet connection is required. After downloading, you can experience the complete plot offline at all times, embarking on your dimensional adventure anytime and anywhere. Bid farewell to internet lag and data consumption — the immersive experience is free from spatial and network restrictions.

Convenient One-Click Rewind

Equipped with a one-click rewind function: no reloading is needed, and you can return to any plot node with just a tap. Revisit thrilling combat moments and delicate interaction scenarios, never missing a single plot detail for a more flexible experience.

Immersive Reading Experience

Optimized text typesetting and scene transition effects, coupled with plot-appropriate atmosphere creation, make reading a pleasure. You will feel as if you are immersed in a movie-level plot, enjoying total immersion without distractions.

Auto Plot Progression

Supports an auto plot progression function; you can adjust the playback speed according to your own reading rhythm, freeing up your hands to easily experience the exciting plot. You can also pause at any time to take control of your own adventure pace.

data.short_description: Vincent, a genius heart surgeon and Taoist, suffers cardiac arrest from a toxin plot. He bonds with a super digital lifeform, gaining dimension powers. Together, he uncovers FX Group’s dark conspiracy across the hospital and a haunted house, fighting supernatural foes with allies by his side.
